events.title: The Avars lift their siege of the Byzantine stronghold of Tomis
events.description: In Maurice's Balkan campaigns, the Avars lifted their siege of Priscus' army at Tomis as Comentiolus led a Roman army along the Danube. They routed his troops, but plague later killed much of their army and seven sons of the khagan.

events.title: Sicilian Vespers uprising begins in Palermo
events.description: At the hour of vespers outside the church of Santo Spirito, Sicilians rose against Charles of Anjou's French rule, killing thousands. The island passed to Peter III of Aragon.
events.html: At the hour of vespers outside the church of Santo Spirito, Sicilians rose against Charles of Anjou's French rule, killing thousands. The island passed to Peter III of Aragon.

events.title: Edward I of England sacks Berwick-upon-Tweed
events.description: King Edward I of England sacked Berwick-upon-Tweed, then the richest Scottish burgh and the kingdom's main port for wool exports. It was the first significant battle of the First War of Scottish Independence.
events.html: King Edward I of England sacked Berwick-upon-Tweed, then the richest Scottish burgh and the kingdom's main port for wool exports. It was the first significant battle of the First War of Scottish Independence.

events.title: Allied armies win the Battle of Paris
events.description: Russian, Prussian and Austrian forces stormed the heights around Paris, and the city capitulated that night. Coalition troops entered the next day, and Napoleon abdicated within a week.
events.html: Russian, Prussian and Austrian forces stormed the heights around Paris, and the city capitulated that night. Coalition troops entered the next day, and Napoleon abdicated within a week.

events.title: The United States organizes Florida as a territory
events.description: Florida, once the major part of the Spanish territory of La Florida and ceded to the United States in the 1819 Adams–Onís Treaty, became an organized incorporated territory. It was admitted to the Union as a state in 1845.
events.html: Florida, once the major part of the Spanish territory of La Florida and ceded to the United States in the 1819 Adams–Onís Treaty, became an organized incorporated territory. It was admitted to the Union as a state in 1845.

events.title: Crawford Long uses ether to anaesthetise a patient
events.description: In Jefferson, Georgia, Dr Crawford Long removed a tumour from James Venable's neck after giving him ether. He did not publish until 1849, after William Morton's public demonstration.

events.title: Dominican troops defeat the Haitian army at Santiago
events.description: In the second major battle of the Dominican War of Independence, outnumbered Dominican troops of the Army of the North under General José María Imbert defeated Haitian troops under General Jean-Louis Pierrot at Santiago de los Caballeros.
events.html: In the second major battle of the Dominican War of Independence, outnumbered Dominican troops of the Army of the North under General José María Imbert defeated Haitian troops under General Jean-Louis Pierrot at Santiago de los Caballeros.

events.title: Treaty of Paris ends the Crimean War
events.description: Russia accepted the neutralisation of the Black Sea, barring warships from its waters, and gave up southern Bessarabia. The powers guaranteed the integrity of the Ottoman Empire.
events.html: Russia accepted the neutralisation of the Black Sea, barring warships from its waters, and gave up southern Bessarabia. The powers guaranteed the integrity of the Ottoman Empire.

events.title: United States agrees to buy Alaska from Russia
events.description: William Seward signed a treaty to buy Alaska for 7.2 million dollars, about two cents an acre. Mocked as 'Seward's Folly', it proved rich in gold, fish and oil.

events.title: Ronald Reagan shot outside the Washington Hilton
events.description: John Hinckley Jr. wounded the President and three others, including press secretary James Brady. Reagan, hit in the chest, recovered quickly, and his humour in hospital boosted his popularity.

song: The first prayer of the Sikh holy book, by Guru Nanak. Many Sikhs say it every morning; it asks what true worship is and what God is like.
